36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
213449: Roza Plevitskaya is an Air Force Lieutenant and the only female cosmonaut candidate. She is a former ace pilot who was known as the "White Rose of Sungrad".
213450: She is treated by people as a cursed race and hates humans. For a certain reason, she has a strong will to go to the moon and aims to become an astronaut.
213451: She is a researcher at the institute of biomedical research. She specializes in the ecological study of vampires and is responsible for checking Irina's medical data.
213452: Air force first lieutenant. Since he had longed to fly since childhood, he applied as an astronaut cadet. Has a strong sense of justice and tends to go against unreasonable things.
239621: Slava Koronin is the genius engineer who creates the Republic's starships. His existence is kept secret from the public, and he is referred to only by his title, "Chief Designer".
239622: Fjodor Gergiev is the Supreme Leader of the Republic of Zirnitra, who came to this position after overthrowing the previous government.
239623: Natalia is a dormitory mother in a communal dormitory where the astronaut candidates live,
